title: VooPoo Argus V2 Replacement Pods 2ml
description: The Voopoo Argus Top Fill Cartridge V2 (3-Pack) includes three refillable pods designed for use with the Argus G3 pod kit and other compatible Argus devices. These upgraded V2 pods feature a secure top-filling design and integrated mesh coils that deliver outstanding flavour and vapour production with minimal leakage. Each pod holds up to 2ml of e-liquid and is available in a range of fixed coil resistances to suit your preferred vaping style. Choose the 1.0ohm pod for a tighter, more cigarette-style mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw using nicotine salts or high-PG e-liquids. The 0.7ohm pod offers a slightly airier restricted direct-lung (RDL) draw, while the 0.4ohm option delivers an even more open, almost direct-lung (DTL) experience ideal for 50/50 or High-VG e-liquids. With iCOSM Code 2.0 coil technology, these pods ensure smooth wicking, excellent vapour consistency, and a clean, satisfying vape from the first puff to the last. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced vaper, the Argus Top Fill Cartridge V2 makes refilling and replacing pods easy and mess-free. These pods are Compatible with VooPoo Argus Series Kits Pod Details DTL 0.4ohm ARGUS V2 Pod, We recommend using High VG ( Sub-Ohm) E-liquid Only MTL 0.7ohm ARGUS V2 Pod, We recommend using 50/50 , Nic Salt E-Liquid MTL 1.0ohm Argus V2 Pod, We recommend using 50/50 , Nic Salt or High PG E-Liquid Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
